weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start the 80% is shown as crates inside odd wire-dome cages with ladders stacked on a pier. At seg3:end one crate on the dock is labeled 20% and four on a small red boat are labeled 80%. The cage/ladder objects read as garbled props, not cargo, and the boat is a tiny sliver at the frame edge.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The cargo prop has confusing dome/ladder parts, and the ship, which is the subject, is drawn small and pushed off-frame while the empty pier takes up half the frame.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Put a big container ship in the middle of the frame and have 8 of 10 clean cargo boxes/containers slide onto it while 2 peel off to a truck or plane. Drop the cage/ladder props, shrink the flat pier, and keep the 80%/20% labels in ink, clear of the marks.
